display.question_tr: Which statement does not fit the relationship between faith, worship and good character?
display.explanation_tr: The unit considers faith, worship and good character as distinct but related areas.
options_tr: Faith describes acceptance in the heart.
Good character is reflected in everyday attitudes.
Faith has no connection whatsoever to behaviour.

display.topic: The three as an interconnected whole

source.question_tr: Son tur: İslam’ı tek cümlede nasıl anlatırsın?
source.explanation_tr: Ünite boyunca İslam, yalnızca tek bir davranış alanına indirgenmeyen; inanç, ibadet ve ahlakla ilişkili bütünsel bir din olarak ele alındı.
options_tr: Allah'a yönelişi; inanç, kulluk ve güzel davranışlarla birlikte ele alan bir din
Yalnızca belirli ibadetlerin adını ifade eden bir kavram
Belirli bir milliyete ait kültürel kimlik
Sadece tarihsel olaylardan oluşan bir gelenek
source.correct_answer: Allah'a yönelişi; inanç, kulluk ve güzel davranışlarla birlikte ele alan bir din

display.question_tr: Final round: How would you describe Islam in one sentence?
display.explanation_tr: Throughout this unit, Islam has been considered as a holistic religion related to belief, worship and good character, rather than being reduced to a single area of behaviour.
options_tr: A religion that considers turning to Allah together with belief, devotion and good behaviour
A term referring only to the names of particular acts of worship
A cultural identity belonging to a particular nationality
A tradition made up only of historical events
display.correct_answer: A religion that considers turning to Allah together with belief, devotion and good behaviour

teaching_card.title: Islam considers turning to Allah within the whole of life.

source.question_tr: İman sadece törenlere katılmak değil, kalben inanmakla da ilgilidir. Doğru mu?

display.explanation_tr: This unit emphasises turning to Allah, submission and accepting His guidance as central ideas in Islam.

It belongs only to a particular country
